player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ukupoka kwafwile ukuba mu musango wa [macro micro] na manambala 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ifyakulembapo fyonse fifwile ukuba pakati ka 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: The micro_board, row, or col is out of range.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Uuleteya afwile ukulalisha pa cibokoshi icikalamba icili mupepi.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Icilye ca micro board calicimfiwa kale.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} waleshe mu micro board {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). Player {opponent_id} tayali ku lesa mu {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Umulayi {player_id} alicimfya mu Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
